findings.headline: Migrate this use: directive to a ref directive factory.
findings.why: Solid 2.0.0-rc.21 removes use: directives (the compiler rejects them on native elements); custom element behaviors use ref directive factories with a two-phase pattern: an owned setup phase that creates primitives, effects, and onCleanup registrations, which returns an unowned apply callback that receives the element.
findings.guidance: Replace use:focusTrap={options} with ref={focusTrap(options)} (or ref={focusTrap} when the directive takes no options; arrays compose as ref={[a, b]}). Rewrite the directive itself as a factory function that performs its setup in the owned body and returns the element callback (el) => { ... } for DOM writes. Read the directive's source, identify its element setup and teardown logic, and port them to that pattern.
